Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (1) 📘 Rule violations (0) 📜 Skill insights (0)
1. Shutdown can fail a job when no void happened 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness
>
>Description >
> >
>Exchange._fail calls gw.mark_unreachable before _decide checks self.abandoned, so an
>exchange that shutdown records as usage_unknown rather than a void can still set exit status 3. If
>a first connect fails but its retry is still streaming when shutdown abandons the request, closing
>the upstream socket can send the relay through _fail; _decide then returns None, yet the
>nonzero gateway status fails the job.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[hb/gateway.py[R935-936]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/pull/4/files#diff-fef3562d0489296e808673921d86c962355faa436a870c5f670f6d49e9471f96R935-R936) > >```diff >+ if self.unreached is not None: >+ self.gw.mark_unreachable(self.unreached) >``` >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>abandon() sets abandoned, records the admitted request through _unanswered as a non-void, and
>shuts the upstream socket. The resulting relay error reaches _fail, which marks the gateway
>unreachable before _decide acquires the exchange lock and sees abandoned; _decide returns
>None, but shutdown() selects EXIT_UNREACHABLE from the flag, and the orchestrator fails the
>job on the nonzero status.
>
> > [hb/gateway.py\[569-594\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/aa1b1b93028ce784fc464ca33825e10072a9c36e/hb/gateway.py/#L569-L594) > [hb/gateway.py\[838-841\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/aa1b1b93028ce784fc464ca33825e10072a9c36e/hb/gateway.py/#L838-L841) > [hb/gateway.py\[875-890\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/aa1b1b93028ce784fc464ca33825e10072a9c36e/hb/gateway.py/#L875-L890) > [hb/gateway.py\[923-939\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/aa1b1b93028ce784fc464ca33825e10072a9c36e/hb/gateway.py/#L923-L939) > [hb/gateway.py\[935-938\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/aa1b1b93028ce784fc464ca33825e10072a9c36e/hb/gateway.py/#L935-L938) > [hb/gateway.py\[552-593\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/aa1b1b93028ce784fc464ca33825e10072a9c36e/hb/gateway.py/#L552-L593) > [hb/gateway.py\[879-893\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/aa1b1b93028ce784fc464ca33825e10072a9c36e/hb/gateway.py/#L879-L893) > [hb/gateway.py\[1100-1111\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/aa1b1b93028ce784fc464ca33825e10072a9c36e/hb/gateway.py/#L1100-L1111) >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >`Exchange._fail` marks the gateway unreachable before the locked void decision, so shutdown can record an abandoned request as non-void while the gateway still exits with status 3. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- hb/gateway.py[923-939] >- hb/gateway.py[875-893] > >## Recommended Fix >Move `mark_unreachable` into `_decide`’s locked `if void:` branch, after the `self.abandoned` check and before `_record`, or pass a flag to `_decide` to achieve the same ordering. Keep the status set before a void record becomes visible, but never set it for an abandoned request. Add a test in which the first connect fails, the retry streams, and shutdown abandons the request; the exit status must be 0. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback
